browser_reports.scope: Exact unchanged offline HTML over loopback; declared level20 supplied-inventory fixture, not earned progression. UI-only coverage: first native village-frame verification precedes explicit renderer/composer draw holding; the broad pass omits a separate HUD image. All held screenshots are prefixed ui-only; camera/world pixels during these checks are not normal-render proof. Input, simulation and DOM still use native game RAF; no manual game ticks or UI replacement. The separate native hero report provides world-rendered UI evidence. Map capture, if requested, temporarily restores native draws to create the genuine world snapshot, then holds again before marker selection and its UI-only screenshot. Explicit WebGL fallback isolates the HTML/CSS change from GPU compilation. Viewports and software rendering do not certify physical Bluetooth, Fold or TV performance.
